verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance documents a built-in AI feature, Compliance Navigator AI™, that gives regulatory guidance tailored to industry and location. That establishes an in-product AI assistant, but the evidence shows it only advises; nothing shows it can be handed tasks to carry out, such as filing, updating records or obtaining licenses. missing for 10: evidence the assistant executes or completes delegated tasks, a description of its interaction model or scope, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Compliance Navigator AI™ delivers fast, accurate, and up-to-date regulatory guidance tailored to your industry and location.
